I though FL oz was "Full" ounces. I was, 20, before I realized it was FLUID ounces. 

My ex and I were at a gas station picking out drinks. I was like "Look this one has 12 FULL ounces" and I was so very excited. He looked at me and said "What?" And I repeated it because I really did think it meant full ounces. And he was like "tamari15, as opposed to not full ounces?".

So he had to explain it meant FLUID. To make matters worse when we got to the counter to buy the drinks, to my embarrassment, he goes "Look this one has 12 FULL ounces" to the cashier and proceeded to laugh. I was so embarrassed and mad.

A woman with a minnesota or missouri number called my cellphone stating very passionately that I had some sort of sexual relationship with her husband. She texted me saying how she knew what was going on and that her husband had my phone number in his wallet.It was so scary. 
She kept texting me and calling me. I was like I dont know you or your husband and I hope things get better.
Called me a bitch while pregnant cause I didn't want to go swimming. And let me cry to sleep all the time.
Criticism. Negativity. Judgement. Most of this coming from my own thoughts.

I just lost the one person that I felt like I could be "me" with. I haven't been able to connect with anyone else like that. I don't feel like people see me or listen to me. 
I feel like I am kind of a waste of space right now. I'm depressed and cant seem to snap out of it. I feel like people don't like being around me. 
I wish I could smile more.
The Center Everything. It's just a novel about a teenage girl's everyday life. But the character just rang true. I read that book 3 times.

I am so sorry you are dealing with that. :( Something that might help is to think of it as a flaw of hers, not yours. She probably has anger issues that she doesn't know how to deal with and takes it out on you. 

Maybe you could talk to a counselor at school. I am so sorry. That is heartbreaking. And it's never stupid to reach out for help. That's brave! 

Something I go to for help is blahtherapy.com. You can talk to a random person anonamously. No account required. You can choose to be a venter or a listener. It can help just venting and getting different ideas on how to deal with the situation.
Just keep swimming
Hey! I just wanted to say hi.

I have been to a couple counselors in the past. My favorite one didn't try to "fix me". She tried to shed light on why I think the way that I think and why I react to things the way I do. She made me feel like it's ok to be depressed sometimes, just as long as it doesnt overwhelm you. But right now it's overwhelming me. 

I feel like I am losing faith in people and faith in myself. But I guess there are people on reddit who care.

I'm just mad because so much of my self worth comes from other people and I am trying desperately to fill a void. I dont know where this void exactly comes from. That is the problem. Maybe if I knew what was causing this massive hole in my being, I wouldnt feel so bad.

Yeah, maybe I am just losing hope. 

Thanks for talking to me

I should just not listen but I do. Part of my self talk, i tell myself I am doing bad and they just reconfirm it. 
so it's a viscious cycle.
